steps.note: S1.3.1a states the net target change (JV+RG)x is added whatever the initial side/central values a,c and that a,c are restored, with the quote of line 748 in the paper's role.
S1.3.1b gives central coefficient |S∩T| mod 2, side injection cancelling the intersection-one cases, and net map y<-y+x (self coefficient one only implied by the net map).
S1.3.1b states the complex-case coefficient (|S∩T|-1)/2 cancelled for intersections zero and two.
S1.3.1c gives the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) by forward, inverse, forward invocations, and S1.3.1 says each invocation returns scratch wires to their initial values.
The plan only says every edge joins nested nondegenerate labels (S1.3.4a1); the per-edge residuals and their dimensions (the residual table) are nowhere stated.
S1.3.3c has P⊗<t_X> ⊂ P⊗t_Y^⊥ from t_X⊥t_Y for the label construction, but never states the complement <t_X,t_Y>^⊥ of dimension h-2 as the side-edge residual.
S1.3.4a1 gives center 3->4 as the only decreasing edge losing h, S1.3.4a2 the telescoping with sources N, sinks Wm-N, signed Wm-2N, and S1.3.4a3 the absolute total Wm-2N+2L.
The plan mentions nondegenerate labels and an orthonormal basis of the residual (S2.1) but never the nonalternating argument over F2 or the absorption of alternating planes.
S1.3.4a4 states L_b/N=100/539 for the bit network and 101/539 for the phase network.
S2.1 names kernels per orthonormal-basis vector of the residual but gives no weight additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors and no formula q_V-q_U = sum wt(v)[v.x].
S2.1 asserts the kernels aI+bX_v without the oddness of wt(v), the phase i^{eps[v.x]}, or the H diag(1,-1) H = X step that gives them.
S2.2 applies (C^{eps_h})^{⊗f} to the f axes of slot h for each residual direction and S2.3 counts exactly s_c child calls, one factor per residual vector on the f columns.

S2.1 and S2.3 only assert C^{⊗m} (C^{⊗e}) on every role; the zero/full label frames, the 27-coordinate C^{-1} on X_a->Y_a, the Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}Z_{a,k} repair and the negated X outputs are not stated.
S1.3.4a4 gives L_b/N=100/539<1/2 and S1.3.4b3 gives deficit N-2L>0 since L<N/2, hence s<Wm.
The plan never states eta_b = 339/22587335000000 (or any explicit bit-network deficit value).
The plan never states eta_c = 73/19906842167500 (or any explicit phase-network deficit value).
S1.3.6 states deficit > 20*2^-50, m^{1-2^-50} > m(1-20*2^-50) and s/W < m^tau with tau=1-2^-50 (S9.1 gives tau=sigma); the step log m<20 is not spelled out.
S1.3.7 states the factorization A=E1 Pi E2 with Pi having a ones (quoting the lemma statement, line 1366) but none of the pivot/elimination proof.
The plan never mentions the fixed odd prime avoiding the denominators of a finite table of factors that lets the identities specialize to Z/q^b with invertible triangular factors.
S1.3.8a states a lower triangular transformation costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending order, each as a unit times itself plus a combination of earlier coordinates.
S1.3.8b gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, an interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j, with one interchange per one of Pi and a in all.
The plan uses B=s+E, C_1=20 and Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) but never defines E=64(W+m+1)^3, nu, C_1=max{20,nu+3} or C_0=128mB^2.
S2.8a states A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E at an internal node (branching s, not s/W) and A(e)<=8e at a leaf; the per-invocation count below E is not spelled out.
S2.8b gives the unrolling over at most ceil(log_m d) levels to A(e)<=8dB^{k+1}<=8B^2d^{nu+1} and S2.8c the total below C_0 d^{C_1}; the step B<=m^nu is only implicit.
S2.8d states depth-l values lie in 2^{-(p+l)}Z[i] with modulus <=2^l, reserving p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits is exact, and eps*C_1<1 makes this O(p).
S2.9 states every row of H_0^{⊗D} has absolute row sum one so disk arrays map to disk arrays and the single truncation errs by less than sqrt2 2^-p.

summary: 15 of 26 sub-steps present. Bank-exchange-network (B1-B4) fully present; label-residual-budget has L3 and L5 but not the residual table (L1), side-edge complement (L2) or the F2 nonalternating basis argument (L4); complex-phase-interface has only the tensor-factor count (P3), lacking weight additivity, kernel derivation and endpoint repair; rank-saving has R1 and R4 but not the explicit eta values; matrix-shear has M3 and M4 but neither the elimination proof (M1) nor the fixed prime (M2); simultaneous-layer has S2-S5 but not the constants' definitions (S1).
